summary: Admit first migration from an exact untracked Wellman scaffold when original HEAD contains no governance, preserving all bootstrap ownership checks

delivery.outcome: Admit a first exact installer-owned untracked legacy scaffold when the original committed governance tree is absent; preserve all existing ownership, publication and freshness checks.
nonGoals: Take over another ticket or dirty product source

architecture.decision: Use a checked read of the exact original Git tree. Accept only absent governance or the existing exact committed legacy manifest, then retain installer receipt, clone/HEAD, installed hash, dirty digest, first allocation and lease checks.
architecture.rollback: Revert through independent review and preserve the previously published package and consumer bootstrap receipt.

validation.evidence: Actual immutable installer and real Git allocation preserve foreign dirty bytes and leave source unchanged.
Committed, fresh and untracked scaffold regressions; native manifests, remaining governance and unreadable Git tree refuse admission.
Required checks and independently approved exact-head publication. Immutable release remains gated by the concurrent release owner.
